# Efekan Salman

Personal portfolio in computational neuroscience and bio-inspired AI.
Canonical site: https://efekansalman.github.io/

## Language versions

- English: https://efekansalman.github.io/
- Türkçe: https://efekansalman.github.io/tr/
- Français: https://efekansalman.github.io/fr/
- Nederlands: https://efekansalman.github.io/nl/

## Featured projects

- AxonLM: A modular PyTorch GPT-2 research codebase with transformer feed-forward activation probes. The repository reports AUC 0.963 for neuroanatomical decoding against the Allen Brain Atlas. This number is a repository-reported result, not an independently reproduced measurement. Source: https://github.com/EfekanSalman/AxonLM
- NeuroConscious: An open-source Python testbed for biologically inspired agent behavior, including internal state, mood, motivation, and environment interaction. Source: https://github.com/EfekanSalman/NeuroConscious
- Neuromorphic STDP-SNN: A spiking-network simulator using LIF neurons, STDP synaptic plasticity, and winner-take-all inhibition. No benchmark score is published on this site. Source: https://github.com/EfekanSalman/neuromorphic-stdp-snn

## Interactive learning

- LIF and STDP teaching lab: https://efekansalman.github.io/#stdp-lab — visitors can vary input current, firing threshold, and spike timing. Its numerical values are illustrative simulations, not measured results from the STDP-SNN project.
